newsitem.title: CYPRUS: OPEC June output dips 410,000 bpd in June - MEES.
newsitem.headline: OPEC June output dips 410,000 bpd in June - MEES.

text.p: OPEC June output fell 410,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 26.35 million bpd after a delay in the resumption of Iraqi exports under the United Nations oil-for-food deal, the Middle East Economic Survey (MEES) newsletter reported on Monday.

Iraqi output fell 720,000 bpd to 600,000 bpd in June but this was offset by Iran which lifted production by 140,000 bpd, the United Arab Emirates 120,000 bpd, Qatar 50,000 bpd and Nigeria 25,000 bpd, Cyprus-based MEES reported.

Venezuela remained OPEC's largest quota buster at 3.22 million bpd compared to its quota of 2.359 million bpd. In addition, it produced 41,000 bpd of condensates and 186,000 bpd of natural gas liquids.
Qatar's output steamed ahead to 650,000 bpd in June from a revised 600,000 bpd in May, MEES reported.

Qatar's onshore Dukhan field was now running at 275,000 bpd, offshore Qatar Marine stream at 135,000 bpd, Idd el-Shargi at 95,000 bpd, Al-Shaheen at 96,000 bpd, Al-Rayyan at 32,000 bpd and Al-Khaleej at 17,000, MEES reported.
Iranian flows recovered to 3.618 million bpd last month, based on exports of 2.418 million bpd which was a 138,000 bpd increase over the May average.
Iran's exports in the first half of 1997 have averaged 2.417 million bpd versus 2.567 million bpd in the first half of last year, MEES reported.
Exports of Iranian crude to Asia rose to an average of 1.028 million bpd in the first six months of the year from 931,000 bpd, helped by an increase in Japanese sales to 508,000 bpd from 450,000 bpd.
European sales dipped to 379,000 bpd from 498,000 bpd.
UAE output rebounded in June after May maintenance work.

Output in Abu Dhabi, the main oil emirate in the UAE, was broken down as : ADCO onshore 900,000 bpd, ZADCO offshore 600,000 bpd (Upper Zakum 565,000 bpd, Umm Addalkh and Satah fields 35,000 bpd), ADMA-OPCO offshore 450,000 bpd and other offshore fields 70,000 bpd.
Saudi Arabia, excluding the 140-150,000 bpd of output from the Abu Safah field which now all goes to Bahrain, was pegged at its quota of 8.00 million bpd.
A Reuter survey put the 11-member group output at 26.39 million bpd in June.
